implementation: Cryptographic library for TOP DL V2.1
description: TOP DL V2.1 is a highly secured smartcard platform compliant with the Javacard 2.2.2, GP 2.1.1 & GP 2.2 Amdt D standards, designed to operate with the NXP P60xx chip. It supports: TDES, AES, AES-CMAC, SHA1-224-256-384-512, RSA, RSA CRT, ECDSA, ECC CDH, KDF SP800-108 & DRBG SP800-90A algorithms.
